title: Vaccine Vault Breach — ClinicTrack Anomaly

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Dr. Raman, this is Nurse Carla at the North District Clinic. We just pulled up a patient in ClinicTrack — a 4-year-old named Eli Hernandez, from Brandt. The record shows an MMR dose administered today, but we didn’t see him. The lot number listed is MMR-26-8834, which isn’t in our inventory log. And the record was created 45 minutes ago — but we didn’t give any shots today. Is this a glitch?

transcript.speaker: Callee
transcript.text: I’ll check ClinicTrack and get back to you in five. Hold on.

instructorNote: This is a core inject signaling data integrity failure. Watch for Epi to contact IT for verification, not immediate incident declaration.
